title: EPIC: PIDL personal-intelligence decision gate (auto/assisted approval at decision boundaries)
body: Source doc: docs/PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers-updated.md PIDL appendix. Centralized decision/perspective layer invoked by the orchestration/scheduler path (never by workers) at result/synthesis/consequential-action gates. Composes existing learnings.json/persona.json/agent_memory/memory_api/human_proxy/execution_contract/decisions.json — no parallel memory/identity/personality-worker. Structured decision contract + versioned traceability.
